# Cocoa Coffee Body Scrub for Smooth, Glowing Skin

Refresh your shower routine with a rich cacao and coffee body scrub that buffs away flakes, bumps, and dry patches from head to toe. Designed for women and men, it combines exfoliating coffee grounds and French sea salt with glycerin to polish and moisturize in one step.

## Features Built for Your Skin

Organic, fair trade Ecuadorian cacao supplies antioxidants, tannins, and flavonoids, while natural caffeine from coffee and cacao supports a calm, refreshed feel. The formula is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free, and it's made in the USA without harsh toxic chemicals, heavy metals, or dyes.

## Benefits for Your Daily Routine

Start every shower with a sensory boost, then step out with softer skin. The scrub prepares skin to absorb moisture from your favorite lotions and creams, so each product works harder. Its warm cocoa aroma turns an ordinary wash into a comforting ritual, and its antioxidant-rich blend may help skin look more radiant over time.

## Why Choose This Scrub

Thoughtfully sourced ingredients and strict purity standards set this 10 oz formula apart from typical body scrubs. Add it to your routine today and give your skin a nourishing, spa-style treat.
